questions.question: Analyze the advantages of the IT Act 2000 and explain how it benefits businesses
questions.solution_html:
• and individuals. [An] / [CO5]
  • The IT Act 2000 provides several advantages by giving legal recognition to electronic
  • records and digital signatures, enabling secure online transactions and boosting e-
  • commerce. It enhances cybersecurity through provisions against hacking, data theft, and
  • cyber fraud, thereby protecting both businesses and individuals. The Act supports
  • smooth functioning of e-governance services by allowing digital filing of documents
  • and online communication with authorities. It benefits businesses by reducing
  • paperwork, increasing transaction speed, and promoting digital trust, while individuals
  • gain protection against cybercrimes, misuse of personal data, and online harassment.
  • Overall, the Act strengthens the digital ecosystem, improves operational efficiency, and
  • builds confidence in electronic transactions.

questions.question: Analyze the different types of logistics providers and explain their key functions,
questions.solution_html:
• highlighting how each type supports supply chain efficiency. [An] / [CO1]
  • Logistics providers include 1PLs, which involve companies managing their own
  • transportation and storage, offering full control but limited scalability; 2PLs (service
  • carriers) that provide basic transport or warehousing services, helping reduce asset
  • ownership and operational burden; and 3PLs that offer integrated services like
  • transportation, warehousing, inventory management, and order fulfillment, improving
  • efficiency through expertise and technology. 4PLs act as supply chain integrators,
  • managing multiple 3PLs, optimizing processes, providing end-to-end visibility, and
  • enhancing strategic coordination. 5PLs focus on managing entire networks through
  • advanced digital platforms, e-procurement, and automation, driving cost efficiency and
  • global optimization. Each type supports supply chain efficiency by improving service
  • quality, reducing costs, enhancing coordination, and leveraging technology according to
  • the level of service integration.

questions.question: What are the main types of e-advertisements? Discuss their advantages.
questions.solution_html:
• [U]/[CO3]
  • The main types of e-advertisements include display ads, which use banners and visuals to
  • attract attention and build brand visibility; search engine ads, which appear based on user
  • keywords and offer high relevance and conversion potential; social media ads, which
  • target specific audiences using demographics and interests, improving reach and
  • engagement; video ads, which deliver strong storytelling and higher retention; email
  • marketing ads, which offer personalized promotions to existing or potential customers;
  • and influencer promotions, which leverage trusted personalities to increase credibility.
  • These e-advertisements are advantageous because they provide targeted reach, cost-
  • effectiveness, real-time performance tracking, global accessibility, personalized
  • messaging, and higher engagement compared to traditional advertising.
